digest.component_or_area: codebase module-size management and CI gate
propositions: Module-size headroom across the rebar codebase is exhausted: 46 of 435 src/rebar Python files exceed 700 LOC, with 7 files at or within 4 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap.
pass1.py (800 LOC) and push.py (799 LOC) must be split by extracting clean seams to restore headroom while preserving backward compatibility through re-exports.

The near-cap leading indicator (module_size_distribution.near_cap_count) exists but is not surfaced to users; a non-blocking CI warning must report files in the headroom band (within 10% of cap) to prevent future contributors from discovering the problem while already blocked.

All module extractions must avoid load-bearing monkeypatching hazards (push._git at 25+ test sites) and ContextVar scope ownership (pass1._submit_ctx must move to generation.py, not container_stage.py, to capture the correct _CANCEL_SCOPE).
